$schema: Templates the world uses to phrase memory tags as creatures live. {place}, {other}, {species} are filled at runtime. Kinds: place (on arriving somewhere), meeting (on encountering another creature), idle (ambient flavour). Add lines freely — the world picks one at random.

idle: drifted with no errand in mind
followed a sound that wasn't there
counted the stars twice and lost the count
remembered the sea, or something like it
